subject: general
question: While renaming a file or folder in MS Windows, what happens if a user changes the file extension (e.g. from .txt to .doc)?

options.text: The file will no longer open or be accessible.
The file format automatically changes to match the new extension.
A warning is displayed to confirm the change in extension.
The file is converted to another program's file format.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A warning is displayed to confirm the change in extension**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• In MS Windows, file extensions are used to identify the file type and determine which program should open it.
 
• When a user renames a file or folder and changes the file extension, a warning message is displayed by the system.
